typeScale: headline ~4% of canvas height, subheadline ~3-5%, offer badges ~2%, cta ~3%, legal ~1%
colourBlocking: Top 75% of the canvas is a solid light grey background, while the bottom 25% is a solid bright green background, creating a distinct visual anchor for the CTA.
negativeSpace: Generous negative space surrounds the headline stack and separates the product groups, enhancing readability and allowing key elements to stand out. Significant breathing room within the bottom green block ensures the CTA is highly visible.
eyePath: The eye is drawn from the bold headlines at the top, down to the two distinct product groupings and their associated offer badges, then to the emphasized green offer text, and finally to the prominent CTA on the contrasting background.
whyItWins: The layout wins by clearly segmenting a complex offer into easily digestible visual blocks, using strong colour contrast and distinct typography to guide the eye directly to the value proposition and call to action.
